title: schkuhria anthemoidea var. wrightii
intro: Schkuhria anthemoidea var. wrightii, commonly known as Wright's skunkweed or Yerba de la Santa María, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and treating various health conditions. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
